A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the color combinations of black or white and negative image polarity are preferred by users, and the color combinations of green, turquoise, and purple are not preferred by users.
color combination is a more important factor in user preferences than polarity.

the color combination of the top 16% preferred by subjects was white-on-black, black-on-white, and yellow-on-black, and the color combination of bottom 16% preferred was green-on-white, turquoise-on-black, and purple-on-white.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the color combinations of VDT icons are important for user preference and the color combinations of top and bottom 16% can be used as a reference for VDT design.
the color combinations of VDT icon should be carefully selected based on users' preferences and EEG responses.
